display_information.name: Oxagen
display_information.description: Posts notices from your Oxagen workspace to the Slack channel you pick.
display_information.long_description: An owner or admin of your Oxagen organization connects Slack in Organization settings and picks one channel for the organization's notices. The first notice Oxagen sends is a change in the health of your steering repository. Oxagen asks for four permissions: post messages, post in public channels it has not joined, and list public and private channels so you can pick one.
